description: Write-scope overlap vectors shared by the planner validator and the DAG assignment stage. Every 'overlap' pair must be refused by one of the two layers; every 'disjoint' pair may be assigned to two different developers. 'rejected_whitespace' holds scopes that are only invalid because of surrounding whitespace: the trimmed spelling is the value that must be checked and stored. 'rejected_items' holds single write-scope items the one scope check refuses (blank, NUL and escaping spellings), and 'mixed_blank_positions' holds multi-item scopes with a blank member in each position, each refused as a whole rather than silently dropping the bad item.
